## About Me

I am a postdoctoral researcher at Zhejiang University,
working in theoretical nuclear physics.

My research focuses on understanding the properties
of strongly interacting matter created in
relativistic heavy-ion collisions.

## Research Interests

- Relativistic heavy-ion collisions
- Relativistic hydrodynamics
- Core-corona picture
- Spin polarization and vorticity
- QCD phase diagram
